data.long_meaning: The name Fredie is derived from the Old English 'frēd' meaning 'peace'. The addition of the suffix 'ie' indicates ruler or leader. In the context of Christian spirituality, Fredie can be seen as a peaceful and powerful leader, guiding others towards inner peace and harmony. The name Fredie carries the meaning “Peaceful ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fredie usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fredie total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
